invariants: Analyzers operate strictly read-only against sealed evidence with post-run digest verification
Outbound network dials are blocked fail-closed returning ErrNetworkForbidden
Private scratch directory is isolated with 0700 permissions and bounds on size and path traversal
Hanging or slow analyzers are terminated upon deadline expiry and their scratch freed
Interrupted runs leaving abandoned scratch directories are cleaned up by CleanOrphans without corrupting sealed evidence
